title: To review
subtitle: Upload many photos at once: the app groups them by garment, analyzes them, and you confirm what goes into the wardrobe.

upload.drop: Drop photos here or tap to choose them
upload.addToOpen: Add photos to the interrupted upload
upload.hint: One garment per photo. Shoot front, back and label one after another: they will be joined into one garment.
upload.done: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}: preparing and analyzing
upload.failed: Upload failed. Try again: photos already sent are not stored twice.

interrupted.title: Upload not finished
interrupted.description: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}} so far. Add more, or close the upload to start the analysis.

paused.title: Analysis paused
paused.description: The AI's daily quota is used up. Analysis resumes on its own around {time}; meanwhile you can review the garments that are ready.

done.title: Every photo of this upload is sorted.

summary: {garments, plural, one {# garment} other {# garments}}, {ready} ready to confirm
ungrouped: {count, plural, one {# photo still being prepared} other {# photos still being prepared}}

card.typeMissing: Type missing: open it and pick a type
card.attach: Add the photos to that item

edit.title: Edit garment
edit.description: Fix what the AI got wrong. If a photo does not belong, split it off: it becomes a garment of its own and is analyzed.
edit.bulkDescription: Only the fields you set are applied to every selected garment.
edit.splitHint: Make this photo a garment of its own

toolbar.mergeHint: The selected photos are the same garment

actions.confirmed: {count, plural, one {# garment added} other {# garments added}} to the wardrobe
actions.skipped: {count, plural, one {# garment is not ready yet} other {# garments are not ready yet}}
actions.discarded: {count, plural, one {Garment discarded} other {# garments discarded}}
actions.attached: Photos added to the item you already had
actions.split: Photo split off: it will be analyzed as a garment of its own

discardConfirm.title: {count, plural, one {Discard this garment?} other {Discard # garments?}}
discardConfirm.description: The photos are deleted and do not go into the wardrobe.

abandon.title: Delete this upload?
abandon.description: Photos not yet confirmed are deleted. Garments already confirmed stay in the wardrobe.

disabled.title: Feature not enabled
disabled.description: The review upload is turned on with BATCH_UPLOAD_ENABLED=true in the server's .env file.
